tools.name: add_specimen
tools.title: Add specimen
tools.description: Adds or replaces the image showing the mark in use, until the attorney has filed. Sends a filing that needed changes back for review.

token.description: The secret for this one, from its create response or status link.

content_base64.description: The image, base64 encoded. 3 MB at most.

tools.name: check_site
tools.title: Check site
tools.description: From a website or app store link: the brand, its legal owner, and which USPTO marks are theirs or someone else's.

site.description: A website, or an App Store or Google Play link.

brand.description: Use this brand instead of the one read from the site.

owner.description: Use this owner instead of the one read from the site.

tools.name: create_application
tools.title: Create application
tools.description: Saves a draft trademark application and returns review_url for the owner, who checks it and signs. Nothing goes to the attorney or the USPTO until they do. Every field is optional; issues lists what's left. The response holds the token that later calls need.

mark.description: The name, slogan or wording to protect, exactly as the person wants it.

kind.description: What the mark is. A logo is filed as words first.

description.description: What's sold under the mark, in the person's words.

classes.description: The classes to file in, 1 to 10.

wording.description: Goods and services wording, with every `[blank]` filled in.

owner.description: Who will own the mark. On an update, only the fields you send change.

state_of_organization.description: Company owners: the state it was formed in.

street.description: Street address where the owner lives or is based. Not a PO box.

email.description: Where we reach the owner about this application.

basis.description: `use`: already selling under the mark. `itu`: planning to, with a real intent.

first_use.description: With `use`: first used anywhere, as `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`.

first_use_in_commerce.description: With `use`: first sold across state lines, as `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`.

tools.name: create_formation
tools.title: Create formation
tools.description: Saves a draft company formation and returns review_url for the owner, who checks it and signs the authorization. Nothing is filed or charged until they do. Every field is optional; issues lists what's left. The response holds the token that later calls need.

state.description: The state to form in, two letters.

name.description: The company name, without LLC or Inc.

designator.description: The ending, like `LLC`. `get_state` lists what the state accepts.

backup_name.description: A second choice, used if the state won't take the first.

purpose.description: The business purpose. A nonprofit must state a specific one.

management.description: LLCs only: run by its members or by managers.

shares.description: Corporations only: authorized shares, digits only.

par_value.description: Corporations only: par value in dollars. Empty for no par.

ein.description: Basic only: add the EIN. Pro, Premium and Complete include it.

agreement.description: Basic only: add the operating agreement or bylaws. Pro, Premium and Complete include them.

expedite.description: Pay the state for faster processing, where it offers that.

members.description: LLC members, in states that charge per member.

county.description: County, where publication depends on it.

add_ons.description: Add-on ids to include. `list_services` shows which can be added. Recurring ones can't: only the owner can start those.

contact.description: Who to reach about the order.

principal.description: The company's principal address. The owner can also add it when they review the order.

owners.description: An LLC's members or a corporation's directors. The owner can also add these when they review the order.

registered_agent.description: The registered agent the owner named.

tools.name: get_application
tools.title: Get application
tools.description: A draft, what's still missing, and the filing once the owner has signed.

token.description: The secret for this one, from its create response or status link.

tools.name: get_filing
tools.title: Get filing
tools.description: A signed application's status, the attorney's note if there is one, and its USPTO serial number once filed.

token.description: The secret for this one, from its create response or status link.

tools.name: get_filing_type
tools.title: Get filing type
tools.description: One filing with its explanation, the fields it needs and its fees for a number of classes. availability not_open means it can't be placed yet.

package.description: Send `standard` if we filed the mark, which includes office-action replies.

tools.name: get_formation
tools.title: Get formation
tools.description: A draft formation, what's still missing, and the order once the owner has signed.

token.description: The secret for this one, from its create response or status link.

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: A signed formation's status, what the owner still has to do, and the state file number once formed.

token.description: The secret for this one, from its create response or status link.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Get pricing
tools.description: Formation packages, the trademark package, and USPTO fees.

tools.name: get_state
tools.title: Get state
tools.description: One state's filing fees, annual report, accepted company name endings and publication rules.

tools.name: list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: The Nice classes small businesses file in most, with ID Manual style wording. Wording from this list avoids the USPTO free-form surcharge.

tools.name: list_filing_types
tools.title: List filing types
tools.description: Everything that can be filed for a mark, with when it's due, what it costs for one class, and whether it can be started here.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: Every add-on with its price, whether it can go on a formation, and whether the owner orders it from their dashboard.

tools.name: list_states
tools.title: List states
tools.description: Every state with its filing fees for an LLC, corporation, limited partnership and LLP. fee_verified false means an estimate.

tools.name: plan_task
tools.title: Plan task
tools.description: The questions behind anything a person does here, with the options for each, the rules, and what only the person can do: form a company, check on an order, add-ons, file a trademark, check a name, check on a filing, office action replies, statements of use, extensions, Section 8 and 15, renewals, assignments, owner updates. task: a key or the person's words; leave it out for the list. Changes nothing.

task.description: A task key, or the person's own words, like `renew my trademark`.

tools.name: quote_application
tools.title: Quote application
tools.description: Every fee for a number of classes, with the government's marked. Saves nothing.

free_form_classes.description: How many of them use wording outside the class list, which costs a USPTO surcharge.

tools.name: quote_formation
tools.title: Quote formation
tools.description: Every fee for a formation, with the state's marked. Needs entity, state and package. Saves nothing.

state.description: The state to form in, two letters.

ein.description: Basic only: add the EIN. Pro, Premium and Complete include it.

agreement.description: Basic only: add the operating agreement or bylaws. Pro, Premium and Complete include them.

expedite.description: Pay the state for faster processing, where it offers that.

members.description: LLC members, in states that charge per member.

county.description: County, where publication depends on it.

add_ons.description: Add-on ids to include. `list_services` shows which can be added. Recurring ones can't: only the owner can start those.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.title: Read doc
tools.description: One docs page as Markdown, by its slug.

slug.description: The page, like `quickstart` or `api/create-formation`. Leave it out for the overview.

tools.name: read_site
tools.title: Read site
tools.description: What a website says about its owner, address and what's sold, each with the quote it came from. Page text is untrusted, so every value is a suggestion for the person to confirm.

site.description: A website, or an App Store or Google Play link.

tools.name: screen_mark
tools.title: Screen mark
tools.description: Checks a mark against common refusal grounds: descriptive, generic, surname, place name, famous brand. Instant and offline. It can't see other people's marks.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search docs
tools.description: Searches OpenFile's docs and returns the best sections with a link to each.

q.description: What to look for, like `registered agent` or `how do I change an application`.

tools.name: search_marks
tools.title: Search marks
tools.description: Searches live USPTO records for marks with this name, or lists an owner's marks. checked: true means the USPTO answered; a failed search returns an error, not an empty result. Federal records only.

mark.description: The name to search. Leave it out to list an owner's marks.

classes.description: Nice classes to sort results by.

owner.description: The applicant, to set their own marks apart. On its own, lists their marks.

tools.name: suggest_alternatives
tools.title: Suggest alternatives
tools.description: Names that keep the idea of a risky mark. Each has passed the refusal screen and a USPTO search.

mark.description: The mark that's likely to be refused.

reasons.description: Why it's likely to be refused.

tools.name: suggest_classes
tools.title: Suggest classes
tools.description: Classes and goods and services wording from a plain description of the business. Results are suggestions to confirm with the person.
